notes: Breadth-first search over floors the program generates: the two neighbours of a floor are floor + up and floor - down when they are inside the building. Pressing toward the goal fails when the lift must first move away from it; a stack finds a route, not the shortest one.

traps: the lift must first move away from the goal
a goal no sequence of presses reaches
start and goal are the same floor
a press that would leave the building

rejects.name: always presses the button that points toward the goal
searches with a stack instead of a queue
